description: Search council, planning commission and zoning board decisions by place, body, action and meeting date. RECOMMENDED_* is a recommendation, not a final decision. A decision does not guarantee construction. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks a lower bound; total_unknown means the total is unknown. Pagination guidance is in _notes.

address.description: Street address named in the item, partial

case_number.description: A case number named in the item (formatting ignored)

city.description: City name (matches the address city or the deciding jurisdiction)

linked.description: true: only items linked to a planning case we hold

outcome.description: Normalised action: APPROVED, DENIED, RECOMMENDED_APPROVAL, TABLED, ...

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: search_pipeline_decisions
title: Search planning decisions
